turnSecretSet.description: Whether a TURN shared secret is stored. The secret itself is write-only and never returned.

turnStaticCredentialsPresent.description: Whether credentials from the removed static TURN username and password settings still exist.

maxVideoProfile.description: Highest camera profile Meet may select. Clients still pick the profile automatically.

maxVideoProfileRelay.description: Highest camera profile a sender may use while its selected candidate pair is relayed. Clamped to maxVideoProfile.

debugLogging.description: Browsers write detailed RTC logs to their console after a reload.

forceRelay.description: Stored switch. Served to clients only while a TURN relay is configured.
